summary.zh: 让双语路由不用手写重定向，切换语言时能留在原页面。
summary.en: Keeps bilingual routing honest — language switching lands on the same page, not the homepage.

summary.zh: 滚动动效里少数能同时管好性能与降级的库。
summary.en: One of the few scroll libraries that handles both performance and reduced-motion properly.

summary.zh: 整站预渲染成静态文件，图片优化省掉了自己搭管道的时间。
summary.en: The whole site ships as static files; built-in image optimisation saved me a pipeline.

summary.zh: 构建时批量读封面主色调，占位色就是这么来的。
summary.en: Batch-reads cover colours at build time — that is where the placeholder tint comes from.

summary.zh: 把 Bento 网格的跨列关系先画清楚，再动键盘。
summary.en: Draws out the Bento spans before any code, which is where the layout actually gets decided.

summary.zh: 风光组片的调色基准，导出色调直接影响这里的主色调占位。
summary.en: The grading baseline for landscape sets; its output tint feeds the dominant-colour placeholder here.
